# Inert extraction fixtures

These saved source snapshots, SCIP indexes, graphs, hashes and expected data support
Rust indexer tests and [offline extraction tools](../../../tools/extraction/README.md).
Do not install or execute the copied Feature Factory package. Tools only parse its
saved source and index data. Original fixture files were moved byte-for-byte.
Embedded paths in graph/index metadata describe the historical extraction run.

Historical reports and screenshots are in
[`docs/research/extraction`](../../../docs/research/extraction/).
